series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality with high noise levels. Concept drift and unstable model rankings suggest a weighted combination with dynamic error adaptation is appropriate to account for shifting model performance.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.6: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift suggests dynamic error weighting (ADE) is appropriate to adapt to shifting model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.8727 AND series_profile.combination_recommendation.top_k=4 → high model performance variance with recommended top_k=4 justifies inverse-RMSE weights with shrinkage
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few training windows
